title: smokedrift
description: Adds a stylish purple smoke trail behind your player with customizable intensity and toggle controls.
body:
💜 Smokedrift

Turn your movement into pure style with Smokedrift — a lightweight and customizable mod that adds a smooth dark purple smoke trail behind your player.

Whether you're exploring, PvPing, or just flexing, Smokedrift gives your movement a clean and aesthetic look without affecting performance.

✨ Features
💨 Smooth purple smoke trail behind your player
🎮 Toggle ON/OFF using a keybind (k)
🎚️ Adjustable intensity via in-game GUI
🧍 Visible only to you (client-side)
⚡ FPS-friendly and highly optimized
🎨 Dark, clean, and stylish visual effect
⚙️ Controls
Press your assigned key to toggle the smoke effect
Open GUI to adjust smoke intensity and settings
🧠 Performance

Smokedrift is designed to be lightweight and smooth, ensuring no FPS drops even on low-end systems.

📦 Compatibility
✔ Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.11
✔ Fabric Loader required
✔ Works on most servers (client-side mod)
🚀 Why Smokedrift?

If you want your movement to look unique, clean, and eye-catching, this mod is made for you.

📥 Installation
Install Fabric Loader
Download the mod
Put the .jar file into your mods folder
Launch the game and enjoy 🔥 
 [Fabric Api,Cloth Config] Required
💬 Made for style. Made for performance.
